title: A positive solution to Tingley’s problem

abstractEnglish: Every surjective isometry between the unit spheres of real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry, giving an affirmative solution to Tingley's problem. If distances between different radii are not preserved, we realize the positive maximal defect in a possibly enlarged pair of Banach spaces. We then align extremal chords using common supports and Darbo's fixed-point theorem and obtain a contradiction from support and convexity estimates.
titleEn: A positive solution to Tingley’s problem

details.overview: 稿件研究实Banach空间单位球面间的满等距映射。作者声称证明了任意两个实Banach空间单位球面间的满等距映射可唯一延拓为满实线性等距，从而肯定解决Tingley问题。若不同半径间距离不被保持，作者在可能扩大的Banach空间对中实现正的最大缺陷，并利用公共支撑、Darbo不动点定理及支撑与凸性估计导出矛盾。摘要未提供完整证明或独立验证。
keyPoints: 证明实Banach空间单位球面间的满等距唯一延拓为满实线性等距。
对距离不保持情形，在扩大空间对中实现正最大缺陷并导出矛盾。
